title: A masked edit shows the model only the mask box, so it cannot keep what is outside it

reason: Corrected: the crop holds the boy's whole reflection, not 'pure water'. Fabio caught the claim; the pixels settle it. The failure is the crop losing the reflection RELATIONSHIP, not the subject.
Not a defect. The crop is what masking is; the prompt has to be crop-local. Fixed as a prompt rule under MPI-877.
